chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl narrated from Ibn Bukayr, from ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
Regarding a man who is apprehended while multiple hudud are due upon him, one of them being execution.
He said: "ʿAlī عليه السلام used to carry out the hudud upon him first, then execute him, and do not oppose ʿAlī عليه السلام."

key_terms.حُدُودٌ: Prescribed legal punishments set by the Sacred Law.
key_terms.لَا تُخَالِفْ عَلِيًّا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَا: A directive not to oppose the legal judgment and practice of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام.
key_terms.يُقِيمُ عَلَيْهِ الْحُدُودَ: He enforces the prescribed punishments upon him.

ai.seo_question: If a person is liable for multiple hudud and one of them is execution, in what order are the punishments carried out?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person upon whom multiple prescribed punishments are due, including death. It states that Amir al-Mu'minin ʿAlī عليه السلام would first implement the other hudud and then carry out the execution, presenting his practice as the authoritative precedent.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5380 - Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal narrated from Ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd ibn Zurara, who narrated from Abu Abdullah (as)
regarding a man who was apprehended with multiple legal punishments (hudud) upon him, one of which was execution.
Imam (as) said: "Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) used to carry out the other hudud first and then execute him. Do not oppose Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as)."
